records.context: Keep the app dock present and preserve its width and collapse controls.
records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.apply_dock_mode#0
records.source: Keep the app dock present and preserve its width and collapse controls.
records.translation: Haltu forritakvínni sýnilegri og varðveittu breidd hennar og stýringar til að fella hana saman.

records.context: Legacy visibility preferences and ``mode`` no longer hide the dock. Navigator starts collapsed unless an explicit collapse choice is saved. Switching back restores the ordinary dock's collapse state.
records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.apply_dock_mode#1
records.source: Legacy visibility preferences and ``mode`` no longer hide the dock. Navigator starts collapsed unless an explicit collapse choice is saved. Switching back restores the ordinary dock's collapse state.
records.translation: Eldri sýnileikastillingar og ``mode`` fela ekki lengur kvína. Navigator byrjar með kvína samanfellda nema skýrt val um stöðuna hafi verið vistað. Þegar skipt er til baka er samanfellingarstaða venjulegu kvíarinnar endurheimt.

records.context: Idempotent, and safe to call before the menu exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.apply_dock_mode#2
records.source: Idempotent, and safe to call before the menu exists.
records.translation: Óbreytanlegt við endurtekningu, og öruggt að kalla áður en valmyndin er til.

records.context: Expand the app dock and focus its first row from the menu or shortcut.
records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.toggle_app_drawer#0
records.source: Expand the app dock and focus its first row from the menu or shortcut.
records.translation: Opnaðu forritakvína og færðu fókus á fyrstu línu hennar úr valmyndinni eða með flýtilykli.

records.context: The dock stays beside the current module. Its collapse control remains available, and legacy visibility preferences do not disable this action.
records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.toggle_app_drawer#1
records.source: The dock stays beside the current module. Its collapse control remains available, and legacy visibility preferences do not disable this action.
records.translation: Kvíin helst við hlið núverandi einingar. Stýringin til að fella hana saman er áfram aðgengileg og eldri sýnileikastillingar gera þessa aðgerð ekki óvirka.
